name: Shine out of combos
goal: Shine on the first frame after hitstun, between the hits of a string
why: A string that is not a true combo leaves a few frames in which Fox can act before the next hit. His shine hits on its first frame: started in that gap, it stops the string and turns it around.

tutorial.what: The opponent comes in with a string. Take the first hit, hold the stick down through the hitstun, and press B on the first frame Fox can act.
tutorial.expect: The opponent plays footsies and starts its string when Fox comes in, or comes in itself: another opponent, string and damage every try. Each is judged when the shine hits, when the second attack lands, or once it has missed: whether Fox shined, and how soon.

marks.FREE: Frame {FREE}: Fox can act. B: the shine

lessons.title: A string with a gap
text: Not every string is a combo. {opp}'s {first} leaves Fox in hitstun for a few frames; the {second} after it lands on frame {SMASH}, and at {PCT}% Fox can act on frame {FREE}.
Whatever he starts in those {SMASH-FREE} frames comes before the {second}, if it is fast enough. The more damage Fox has, the longer the hitstun.

lessons.title: The shine
text: Down and B hits on its first frame, all around Fox: nothing else of his is out that fast.
Hold the stick down through the hitstun and press B as it ends. A press during hitstun does nothing and is not kept: the press has to come on a frame Fox can act.

attempt.missed: Not counted: {opp}'s {first} did not land. Let it come in, and take the hit.

in time.expect: The shine within 5 frames of the first frame Fox can act
in time.words: the shine began on frame {at}; Fox could act on frame {FREE}
in time.headline: Late shine
in time.fix: Hold the stick down through the hitstun and press B as it ends: frame {FREE} after {opp}'s {first} at {PCT}%.

strict.expect: The shine within a frame of the first frame Fox can act
strict.fix: Frame {FREE} after {opp}'s {first} is the first Fox can act on: B on it, or the one after.

shined.headline: No shine
shined.fix: Down and B once Fox can act, on frame {FREE} after the {first} at the earliest. The shine hits on its first frame, all around him.

not hit.expect: Not caught by the second attack
not hit.headline: Caught again
not hit.fix: Its {second} lands on frame {SMASH}; Fox can act from frame {FREE}. Start the shine in between.

verdict.success: Shine on frame {at} between {opp}'s {first} and {second}; Fox could act on frame {FREE}.

parts.name: Break the string
parts.teach: {opp} comes in with its {first}, then its {second}. Hold the stick down after the first hit and press B before the second lands.
